title: デビュー戦の後に・偉大なる1歩

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The spectators are enthralled by my running! With a swarm of reporters in wait, I head to the press conference room…

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Only to find a single journalist… plus Doto! Alas, the number of poor souls wallowing in an abyss of despair, ignorant of my presence, appears far too great!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: My next goal is clear—a rescue. With the Overlord's gleaming stride, I will turn the nescient masses into my fans!
